fields.Name: Predictive Studio: Pipelines With More Than One Published Model
fields.UserQuestion: Which training pipelines hold more than one Published model?
fields.Description: The backstop of the publish lock (N8): every pipeline with more than one Published MJ: ML Models row, with the count. The Predictive Studio registry check remediates each through the lifecycle gate: the model with the newest publish record stays, the others are archived.
fields.TechnicalDescription: The contract's SQL text unchanged (RegistryInvariantCheck, D-035): SELECT PipelineID, COUNT(*) AS Published FROM MLModel WHERE Status = 'Published' GROUP BY PipelineID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1. SQL Server only (D-057).

fields.Name: Predictive Studio: Published Models Without A Publish Record
fields.UserQuestion: Which Published models have no publish record, so they were published outside the lifecycle gate?
fields.Description: Every Published MJ: ML Models row with a Delivery and no applied publish, rollback or adopt record in MJ: ML Model Publish Records (D4-204). The Predictive Studio registry check archives each through the lifecycle gate (status-written-outside-gate) and rolls the pipeline back when it is left with no Published model.
fields.TechnicalDescription: MLModel m WHERE Status = 'Published' AND Delivery IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS an MLModelPublishRecord of the model with Kind = 'publish' and Purpose publish, rollback or adopt (D4-204). Pre-change models (Delivery IS NULL) are the pre-change migration's. SQL Server only (D-057).

fields.Name: Predictive Studio: Publish Records Without A Status Change
fields.UserQuestion: Which publish records no longer match their model's status?
fields.Description: The newest applied publish, rollback or adopt record (D4-204) of each model whose model is gone or is neither Published nor Archived: a model moved off Published outside the gate (Validated or KeepBaseline, which the registry check restores through the lifecycle gate) or a record that matches no status change (recorded only).
fields.TechnicalDescription: MLModelPublishRecord r LEFT JOIN MLModel m: Kind = 'publish', Purpose publish, rollback or adopt (D4-204), the model's newest such record (or the model deleted), and the model missing or its Status not Published or Archived. Returns PublishRecordID, ModelID, TrainingRunID, Purpose, ModelStatus, PipelineID. SQL Server only (D-057).

fields.Name: Predictive Studio: Stale Running Scoring Runs
fields.UserQuestion: Which scoring runs have been running since before the threshold?
fields.Description: Every MJ: ML Scoring Runs row still running that started before StartedBefore; the Predictive Studio registry check fails each with the reason (default threshold 6 hours).
fields.TechnicalDescription: SELECT ID, StartedAt FROM MLScoringRun WHERE Status = 'running' AND StartedAt < StartedBefore. SQL Server only (D-057).

fields.Name: StartedBefore
fields.Description: The instant before which a running scoring run counts as stale (ISO).
